prompts.question: How can you tell if (a) is positive or negative before writing the entire equation?
prompts.answer: Compare the (y)-coordinate of the vertex to the (y)-coordinate of the other point. If the (y)-coordinate of the other point is greater, then the parabola opens upward, and (a) is positive. If not, the parabola opens downward, and (a) is negative.

prompts.question: How do (a), (h), and (k) affect the domain and range of a quadratic function in vertex form?
prompts.answer: These values do not affect the domain of the function. The domain is all real numbers. These values affect the range. If (a) is positive, (k) is the minimum value of the range. If (a) is negative, (k) is the maximum value of the range.
